title: The remaining nine roles (Statement, Letter, Contact, Stats, Shop, Library, People, Gallery, Chapters)

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail:
Completes the role set.

Shipped: nine more *.role.json (statement, letter, contact, stats, shop, library, people, gallery, chapters; seventeen in all under lib/blocks/roles), RoleStatement/Letter/Contact/Stats/Shop/Library/People/Gallery/Chapters registered beside the first eight under 'Sections for any theme' (website pages only), three layouts each, same data-role/data-variant/data-part markup, sheet chunks added to components/sites/role-blocks-css.ts reading only the core token contract and emitted only on a page that carries a role block. Contact carries details and a way in, never a form of its own. Pinned by components/page-editor/blocks/roles.test.tsx (seventeen roles on nine themes, every part and variant styled, tokens declared). Rendered on nine themes at 390 and 1280, and frequency and bold at 1440, 1920 and 2000: no horizontal overflow, no empty section.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
